mutations.label: selftest: the verdict is printed as the last line
selftest: per-file times are kept beside the check ledger of this checkout
mutations.only: ^(?:the gate keeps its per-file times beside the check ledger, and says where)$

mutations.label: ADR-077 T2: the suite has a private lease directory
mutations.only: ^a campaign's tests and the selftest use a private lease directory$

mutations.label: ADR-095 T4: the gate says what it ran with and the load it found
ADR-095 T4: an override is said as such
ADR-095 T4: a zero concurrency is not accepted
mutations.from: *[!0-9]*|0|0[0-9]*) printf 'selftest: QH_SELFTEST_CONCURRENCY=%s is not a positive whole number; ignored.\n' "$QH_SELFTEST_CONCURRENCY" ;;
mutations.to: *[!0-9]*|0[0-9]*) printf 'selftest: QH_SELFTEST_CONCURRENCY=%s is not a positive whole number; ignored.\n' "$QH_SELFTEST_CONCURRENCY" ;;

mutations.label: ADR-095 T4: an unreadable load is said as unknown
unused names: the gate runs the per-file linter and keeps its exit
mutations.only: ^the gate, the release scan and every CI job that runs the tests are wired to it$
